patthana23.35:1.1: Nauppanno nakusalo dhammo uppannassa kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… ārammaṇe satta.
patthana23.35:2.1: Nauppanno naakusalo dhammo uppannassa akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… ārammaṇe cha.
patthana23.35:4.1: Nauppanno naabyākato dhammo uppannassa abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo…
